# onetsolutions_instance_available_gpus (Data Source)

Lists the GPU models that can be attached to an instance now, one entry per model.

Only GPUs physically present on the server hosting the instance are offered, one entry per
model, and only while no other instance uses them. Pass a `model` to `onetsolutions_instance_gpu`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_instance_available_gpus" "web" {
  instance_id = onetsolutions_instance.web.id
}

# The hourly rate of each GPU model that can be attached to the instance now.
output "gpu_hourly_rates" {
  value = { for gpu in data.onetsolutions_instance_available_gpus.web.gpus : gpu.model => gpu.hourly_rate }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The UUID of the instance.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `gpus` (Attributes List) The GPU models free on the instance's host, ordered by model; empty when none is. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpus))

<a id="nestedatt--gpus"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gpus`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) The architecture; empty when unknown.
- `cuda_cores` (Number) The number of CUDA cores. Null when unknown.
- `form_factor` (String) The form factor; empty when unknown.
- `fp16_tflops` (Number) The peak FP16 throughput in TFLOPS. Null when unknown.
- `fp8_tflops` (Number) The peak FP8 throughput in TFLOPS. Null when unknown.
- `hourly_rate` (String) The price of an hour of use, as a decimal string.
- `int8_tops` (Number) The peak INT8 throughput in TOPS. Null when unknown.
- `memory_bandwidth_gbps` (Number) The memory bandwidth in GB/s. Null when unknown.
- `memory_type` (String) The memory type, such as `GDDR6`; empty when unknown.
- `model` (String) The model, the value of `model` in `onetsolutions_instance_gpu`.
- `pcie` (String) The PCIe interface; empty when unknown.
- `tdp_watts` (Number) The thermal design power in watts. Null when unknown.
- `tensor_cores` (Number) The number of Tensor cores. Null when unknown.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor, such as `nvidia`.
- `vram_gb` (Number) The memory in GB. Null when unknown.
